name: Macaroni cheese
summary: Macaroni in a mustardy cheddar sauce, baked under more cheese and sliced tomato until the top is golden and bubbling.
about: Macaroni cheese is a weeknight staple that South African kids ask for by name. Families often bake it with tomato slices on top and serve it on its own or beside sausages.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and grease a large ovenproof dish, about 30 × 20 cm.
Cook the macaroni in a large pot of well-salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, so it is still firm. Drain.
While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook, stirring, for 1 minute until it bubbles and smells biscuity.
Pour in the warm milk a little at a time, whisking all the time so no lumps form. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the mustard, nutmeg and 200 g of the cheese until melted. Season well with salt and pepper.
Fold the macaroni into the sauce and tip it into the dish. Lay the tomato slices on top and scatter over the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the top is golden brown. Leave to stand for 5 minutes before serving.
prepNote: Assemble up to a day ahead and refrigerate; bake from cold for 40 minutes.
